entries.fffcb32801777f47: To achieve sustainable growth by 2030, it has set three basic policies: "strengthening the business base," "building a solid management base that supports growth strategies," and "management that emphasizes environmental, social and governance (ESG) factors." As issues to address, it cites diversifying its portfolio through continued active M&A based on profitability and growth potential, stabilizing earnings by expanding stock-type revenue such as maintenance and parts sales in the industrial furnace combustion equipment-related business, establishing technical superiority for next-generation fuels such as hydrogen and ammonia, and developing new customers in the Electronics Business.
